# Spring Boot change request

Implement a change in this repository using the existing project conventions.

## Repository constraints

- Use Java 25 and Spring Boot 4 compatible code
- Use the Maven Wrapper for commands
- Respect parent POM dependency management and BOM imports
- Make the smallest change that fully solves the task
- Keep changes inside the relevant module unless the task requires a broader update

## Verify before finishing

- Build or test with the smallest existing Maven command that proves correctness
- Preserve or update architecture tests when structural rules are affected
- Update GitHub documentation or workflows only when the task directly touches them

## Response expectations

- State which module is affected
- Summarize the user-visible or maintainer-visible impact
- List any follow-up work separately
